descriptions.notStarted: #b#@1072008:##k in #bNautilus#k says there was something very valuable amongst the things she's lost. She says to go talk to #b#@1092002:##k in #bNautilus#k, but there is also something you need to do first.
descriptions.inProgress:
#b#@1072008:##k in #bNautilus#k says you must make something amazing for #b#@1092002:##k.
If you bring her the following materials, she promises to make something special for Baine.

#rPig Vein#k(a drop item from #rRibbon Pigs#k that can be easily found in #b#m100020000##k.)
#rDark Wooden Board#k(a drop item from #rDark Stumps#k that can be easily found in #b#m100040000##k.)
#rYoung Soul#k(a drop item of #rOrange Mushrooms#k.)

Report back to #b#@1072008:##k in #bNautilus#k after you collect all the items.
descriptions.completed: Talk to #b#@1092002:##k in #bNautilus#k to deliver #rKyrinvana's Guitar#k and ask about the #rLost Statue#k.
